cards.note: no agent/session lifecycle listener anywhere in src/; the plugin never sees agent/created
cli.ts shells out to `dsh --dump-config`, it does not use @deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot's assertEntries*/auditStartupEntries
reads no Session history: no eventAt/snapshotEvents/ownEvents call
declares no SessionEventMap member, so no @messageProjection or registerMessageProjection duty
no ctx.hmr use and no cordis.yml watcher; the CLI does not hot-reload config
does not mount or override session-log-deepseek and builds no profile composition that does
no codeRuntime/ptcRuntime use; the plugin executes nothing
implements no SandboxProvider and calls ctx.sandbox nowhere
implements no ShellExecutor and calls ctx.shell nowhere
implements no context.subprocess provider
mounts no workflow engine; no workflow-worker-thread row in cordis.patch.yml
no MCP client row, no @modelcontextprotocol/sdk import
no MCP server and no ctx.mcpResources consumer
local-only execution; no ctx.ssh / dsh-fs-ssh / dsh-subprocess-ssh

implements no LlmAdapter and calls none of offloadRequestImagesWithPolicy / RequestImageOffloadPolicy / offloadedImagePrefixCount (grep: no hits); it is a plain ctx.llm.stream consumer, so the offload duty belongs to the adapter it calls

the classification fallback names the shipped provider route `deepseek-official` and model `deepseek-flash` (both still the base bundle's defaults at 0.2.0-rc.2); the plugin overrides no endpoint, so the Messages-protocol default needs no action, and its cordis.patch.yml touches web-fetch-http only
imports nothing from @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek and ships no model catalog
does not read token measurement or persisted projection state; no contextBreakdown/contextPressure fixture
does not import the assistant provenance/replay type
the client half imports no dsh client node types (only React; AGENTS.md constraint 11)
registers a host command through ctx.commands.register; it builds no CommandClaim (no InputTriggerSource)
never touches the permission projection or the composer tool-row permission control
guide entry now carries a stable id (inbox-vault); one page per kind so `multiple` stays default and the tab owns no process, so no close handler is registered
renders no ui-primitives ConnectionIndicator (no primitives import at all)
does not use DiffBlock or diffTotals
no ?fixture use; development and verification run a real host (docs/help/dev-setup.md)
the patch layer inserts its own row and overrides web-fetch-http; it names no workflow-worker-thread

reads no session log; its two outbound image paths (the classification request and inbox_get's explicit withImage content part) build normal ImageBlocks for ctx.llm, so the image/offload arm is the adapter's and the reader's business, not this plugin's
does not use the ralph tool and does not re-enable it
no mcp-resources row added by the plugin's patch
no code-runtime row in the plugin patch; the web overlay it layers on is untouched by it
depends on none of the retired packages; every peer it names exists at 0.2.0-rc.2 (verified in the installed cohort)
the CLI drives `dsh plugin add` / `--dump-config`, never headless task runs
imports no type from @deepseek-ai/dsh-package-manifest; its dsh.bundle.patch string stays valid
not a harness publisher; no mirrored release set to re-derive
no node-addon-require-builtin in the plugin's own lockfile
targets the Web profile only (README says Windows/web); Desktop is not a supported install target
negative evidence: nothing to act on
resolves no current Session: no sessions.list / useSessions read anywhere (the dock reads tab params, not the session list)
consumes no useSessionPendingInteraction; dock props use only useTabInfo
informational: install path is `dsh plugin add`, which lands the package in dsh.profile.bundles, so the Plugin Manager already manages it
informational: the plugin's own update path already pins exact versions (README update note, docs/help/dev-setup.md)
imports no *16 icon from ui-primitives; the panel draws with lucide-react and inline SVG
uses no workspaceFiles Remote; attachment bytes come back through the plugin's own authenticated fetch route

settings moved onto the plugin's own Cordis Config with .volatile() fields, read through refs and written through ctx.configEditor.edit(ctx.fiber.entry, ...); the legacy settings.yaml sections are adopted once by the plugin because the harness import only maps section id = entry id

the directory-preset copy and the agent-presets.default write are retired; the documented outcome (the assistant sees the inbox tools) is carried by the host tool layer, and a self-declared preset would either replace the agent's whole composition or freeze the shipped standard children
never parses raw session logs
configures no DeepSeek provider row; the patch touches web-fetch-http only
optional: one patch file is enough for this bundle, and the no-reload half is already satisfied by the new .volatile() Config fields (a live edit does not remount the plugin)
informational: nothing in the plugin assumes a boot crash means a missing plugin

optional capability adopted while here: localized Plugin Manager title/description (resolved through the harness's own readPluginMeta); no package-local icon asset under the 256 KiB cap, so the icon field is left out
stores attachment bytes in dsh's attachment store and metadata in its own storage domain; nothing is carried in custom session events
adds no settings-page seat; the panel's own settings app is a different entry point
configures no spill-policy row
informational: no action for a plugin
informational: plugin installation UX is the host's
informational: recorded in docs/help/dev-setup.md that a client-bundle edit needs a host restart before the page sees it

every @deepseek-ai/dsh* peer floored at ^0.2.0-rc.1 (^0.1.5-rc.2 is refused for 0.2.0-rc.2 and ^0.2.0 does not admit the prerelease); cordis ~4.0.4; verified by the install-time preflight on the isolated profile
the toolview card reads the settled content from the phase: 'result' arm only; preparing/start show the pending line instead of an empty result
implements no ConversationNodeDefinition
never reads or writes the transcriptView setting
informational: installs go through dsh plugin add / pnpm as before
host cohort crossed to 0.2.0-rc.2 with ^0.2.0-rc.1 peers; the install-time compatibility preflight accepts every row (dump-config shows the inserted row)
hard-codes no transcriptView fallback
the patch inserts its own row and overrides web-fetch-http; it references no schedule/time-context/ui-schedule id
no otel/analytics ids in the plugin patch; no id collision
never forks sessions
carries no local patch to @deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command
